notes.title: Updated to v.1.2.0
notes.content:
Major UPDATE!

I've tested as much as I could to make sure that the old version won't break but, please, let me know if you encounter any kind of new issues!


Added Steam Cloud integration! 
Share your story state and progression between your computers.

Added additional checkpoints.

Reworked checkpoints system! 
All checkpoints are now stored in the checkpoints vault which you can access from the chest icon at the top. Jump back and forth if you want to play all the possibilities without restarting the game.

Added transition between story and map. 
Added functionality to Center Player button (flag icon at the top) that will bring you to the map while in story mode. Clicking back on the player figure will open up the story.

Added new hints and tips.

Added explanation when selecting your troops that the amount of squads in a unit don't result in damage increase but rather in "HP" increase.

Fixed issue with tedious scrolling of text that was already seen when you resume game.

Fixed issue with dyslexic font rendering with too much white space.


Thanks to everyone who has supported me with constructive feedback and ideas.

notes.title: Updated to v.1.1.0
notes.content:
Balance update on Coalhorn riflemen. Range set to 3 from 4. Movement set to 1 from 2.

Added few UI improvements for Mac Retina Display.

Fixed a critical bug where troops were reduced to 0 but the player could keep playing.
Fixed a critical bug where troops reduced to 0 didn't trigger the defeat condition in hex based battles.
Fixed various typos. 
Fixed UI of assemble squads dialogue showing incorrect number of total squads when it's initially loaded.
